title: Identity normalization of canonical geometric and scalar pullback comparisons
statement:
Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings, and let $T$ be an arbitrary scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Use the ordinary unbounded small-etale derived module categories $D_R(T)=D(T_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and scalar extension $Q_T=-\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. For $R=A,B$, write $P_R=(\mathrm{id}_T)^*_R$ for exact constant-ring inverse image on derived categories [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Let $i_R:P_R\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ and $c_R:P_R\xrightarrow{\sim}P_RP_R$ be respectively the canonical identity comparison and the canonical composition comparison for the pair $(\mathrm{id}_T,\mathrm{id}_T)$, computed by ordinary pullback composition on flat-term K-flat representatives [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons]. Let $\lambda_{\mathrm{id}}:P_BQ_T\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_TP_A$ be the K-flat-normalized scalar/pullback isomorphism [def-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-iso]. Then for $R=A,B$ and every $E\in D_R(T)$,
$$i_{R,E}\circ P_R(i_{R,E})\circ c_{R,E}=i_{R,E},$$
and for every $N\in D_A(T)$,
$$Q_T(i_{A,N})\circ\lambda_{\mathrm{id},N}=i_{B,Q_TN}.$$
Thus the transported identity-identity geometric compositor and the transported scalar/pullback comparison are identity natural transformations. These equations are for the specified comparisons and impose no boundedness or coefficient flatness condition.

proof.text: Let e_R:L(id_R)^* ≅ D((id_R)^*) be the canonical comparison with the exact derived functor. Transport i_R to a_R=e_R^{-1};i_R and transport the geometric compositor to the exact-derived compositor. Expand leftDerivedUpperStarComp and leftDerivedFunctorCompIso. Naturality of e_R^{-1}, followed by cancellation of e_R and its inverse, transports the source-library right unit law to c_R;D((id_R)^*)(a_R)=id. The private helper transport_unit writes precisely this cancellation.

source.place: Tags 0E46 and 0D6D; identity specialization of scalar composition and canonical geometric unit coherence

proof.text: Transport the specified scalarPullbackIso to t:S;G ≅ F;S, where F and G are exact-derived identity inverse images and S is scalar extension. Its invertibility is part of its definition [def-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-iso]. Apply [lem-sf-scalar-pullback-composition] to two identity scheme maps to obtain d_{SN};G(t_N);t_{FN}=t_N;S(c_N). Postcompose with S(F(a_N)). Naturality of t and the right unit equation for c give d_{SN};G(t_N;S(a_N));t_N=t_N. Cancel invertible t_N. Compare with d_{SN};G(b_{SN})=id, cancel d, and use faithfulness of G (which is isomorphic to the identity) to conclude t_N;S(a_N)=b_{SN}. This is the private elementary categorical helper identity_of_composition.

proof.text: Expand t and a_R in the last equation. The consecutive images of e_A and its inverse cancel. Precomposition by e_B^{-1} is injective, so cancelling it gives scalarPullbackIso_N;S(i_A,N)=i_B,SN, exactly the third conjunct. Combine with the first two conjuncts. All calculations hold in the ordinary unbounded derived category; no boundedness or coefficient-flatness hypothesis is added.
